title: Organization root registration, org-root-registration/1 (DEC-0131)
description: What the owner's Fabric POSTs to {issuer}/fabric/membership/v1/{org}/root once (DEC-0131 OX-2): the membership root's public half and the first key set it signed, authorised by the one-time claim the server issued to the owner's account (at most 15 minutes old). The signed set is the proof the sender holds the root. docs/specification/membership.md.

root.description: The root as members pin it (OM-2).

claim.description: The one-time claim: 32 random bytes, base64url, that the server issued to the owner's signed-in account for this organization and delivered by an open link (DEC-0123).

keySet.description: The first org-key-set/1, revision 1, signed by the root; equal to the pending draft.
